state_diagnostics.physical_gap_metric: mean per-object Euclidean distance between the two condition states at matched horizons; agent uses xy L2, block combines xy L2 with 40px-scaled sin/cos angular distance

pixel_diagnostics.same_image_rule: exact decoded uint8 equality; confirm hash matches with array equality

checks.candidate_weighting: deduplicate by exact float32 candidate action bytes inside each source scene, then weight source scenes equally
checks.zero_signal_handling: all source/candidate rows retained; zero-signal ratios are reported and never filtered
